editorial.blurb: Dragon Garden Express delivers craveable Chinese takeout with generous portions and a welcoming hostess, though consistency and cleanliness concerns warrant caution.
editorial.insiderTip: Check your order before leaving—one reviewer paid for a combo but received only the entrée; also, ask for sauces on the side so you can control the heat level, as they do with their Mongolian Beef.

topDishes.note: savory, customizable chili sauce, generous portion
hits the spot for takeout cravings
